python.why: Python is the top language for backend, data, and automation roles
python.learning_activity: Complete Python basics: variables, loops, functions, OOP
python.project: Build a CLI to-do list app
python.interview_question: What are Python decorators and how do they work?
python.short_answer: Decorators wrap a function to add behaviour before/after it runs using the @ syntax.
python.coding_question: Write a Python decorator that logs the name of any function it wraps.

flask.why: Lightweight web framework used heavily in Python backend roles
flask.learning_activity: Build a simple CRUD web app with Flask routes and templates
flask.project: Create a personal blog with Flask and SQLite
flask.short_answer: Flask maps URLs to functions using the @app.route decorator.
flask.coding_question: Write a Flask route that accepts a name as a URL parameter and returns a greeting.

django.why: Full-stack framework required for large Python web projects
django.learning_activity: Follow Django official tutorial, build a polls app
django.project: Build an e-commerce product listing site
django.short_answer: ORM lets you interact with the database using Python objects instead of raw SQL.

sql.why: Data storage and retrieval is essential in every backend and data role
sql.learning_activity: Practice SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY queries on a sample database
sql.project: Design a student database schema and query it
sql.interview_question: What is the difference between INNER JOIN and LEFT JOIN?
sql.short_answer: INNER JOIN returns only matching rows; LEFT JOIN returns all left rows plus matches.
sql.coding_question: Write a SQL query to find the top 3 students with the highest average marks.

git.why: Version control is mandatory in every professional development team
git.learning_activity: Learn git init, commit, push, pull, branch, merge
git.project: Maintain your project history on GitHub
git.interview_question: What is the difference between git merge and git rebase?
git.short_answer: Merge keeps branch history; rebase rewrites commits onto another branch linearly.

rest api.why: APIs connect front-end to back-end and are core to all web services
rest api.learning_activity: Build and test REST endpoints using Flask and Postman
rest api.project: Create a weather data API with Flask
rest api.interview_question: What are HTTP methods GET, POST, PUT, DELETE used for?
rest api.short_answer: GET reads, POST creates, PUT updates, DELETE removes a resource.

linux.why: Most servers run Linux; command-line skills are essential for deployment
linux.learning_activity: Practice basic shell commands, file permissions, process management
linux.project: Deploy a Flask app on a Linux VM
linux.interview_question: What command shows running processes in Linux?
linux.short_answer: The `ps aux` or `top` command shows all running processes.

testing.why: Writing tests ensures code quality and prevents regressions in production
testing.learning_activity: Learn pytest: write unit tests and use fixtures
testing.project: Write tests for your Flask blog app
testing.interview_question: What is the difference between unit testing and integration testing?
testing.short_answer: Unit tests check individual functions; integration tests check how parts work together.
testing.coding_question: Write a pytest unit test for a function that adds two numbers.

excel.why: Excel is used for quick analysis, pivot tables, and stakeholder reports
excel.learning_activity: Learn VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and conditional formatting
excel.project: Create a sales dashboard in Excel
excel.interview_question: What is a pivot table used for?
excel.short_answer: A pivot table summarises and groups large datasets interactively.

pandas.why: Pandas is the standard Python library for data manipulation and analysis
pandas.learning_activity: Learn DataFrame operations: filter, group, merge, pivot
pandas.project: Clean and analyse a real-world dataset from Kaggle
pandas.interview_question: What is the difference between loc and iloc in pandas?
pandas.short_answer: loc uses label-based indexing; iloc uses integer-position-based indexing.
pandas.coding_question: Write pandas code to load a CSV, drop null rows, and print the top 5 rows.

data visualization.why: Charts communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders clearly
data visualization.learning_activity: Learn Matplotlib and Seaborn: bar, line, scatter, heatmap
data visualization.project: Create an EDA dashboard for a sales dataset
data visualization.interview_question: When would you use a box plot?
data visualization.short_answer: A box plot shows distribution, median, and outliers in a dataset.

statistics.why: Statistical thinking is core to drawing correct conclusions from data
statistics.learning_activity: Study mean, median, standard deviation, hypothesis testing
statistics.project: Run a hypothesis test on a sample dataset
statistics.short_answer: A p-value measures the probability that results occurred by chance; <0.05 is significant.

power bi.why: Power BI is widely used for business dashboards and reporting
power bi.learning_activity: Build an interactive dashboard from a sample dataset
power bi.project: Create a sales KPI dashboard in Power BI
power bi.interview_question: What is DAX in Power BI?
power bi.short_answer: DAX is Data Analysis Expressions, a formula language used in Power BI calculations.

html.why: HTML is the foundation of every web page structure
html.learning_activity: Build a multi-page static website with semantic HTML tags
html.short_answer: Semantic HTML uses tags like header, nav, article that describe content meaning.

css.why: CSS controls the visual styling of every web page
css.learning_activity: Learn Flexbox, Grid, and CSS transitions
css.project: Style your portfolio with a responsive CSS layout
css.interview_question: What is the CSS box model?
css.short_answer: The box model describes an element's content, padding, border, and margin layers.

javascript.why: JavaScript adds interactivity and logic to every web page
javascript.learning_activity: Learn DOM manipulation, events, fetch API, and async/await
javascript.project: Build an interactive quiz app in vanilla JS
javascript.interview_question: What is the difference between == and === in JavaScript?
javascript.short_answer: == checks value only; === checks both value and type (strict equality).
javascript.coding_question: Write a JavaScript function that reverses a string without using .reverse().

react.why: React is the most popular front-end library for building dynamic UIs
react.learning_activity: Learn React components, props, state, and hooks
react.project: Build a task manager app with React
react.interview_question: What is the virtual DOM in React?
react.short_answer: React keeps a virtual copy of the DOM and only updates changed parts for performance.

responsive design.why: Sites must look good on all screen sizes, especially mobile devices
responsive design.learning_activity: Learn CSS media queries and Bootstrap grid system
responsive design.project: Make your portfolio fully responsive on mobile
responsive design.interview_question: What is a media query in CSS?
responsive design.short_answer: A media query applies CSS rules only when the screen meets a size condition.

machine learning.why: Core ML discipline: classification, regression, and clustering models
machine learning.learning_activity: Learn supervised and unsupervised algorithms using scikit-learn
machine learning.project: Build a house price prediction model
machine learning.interview_question: What is overfitting and how do you prevent it?
machine learning.short_answer: Overfitting is when a model memorises training data; prevent with regularisation or more data.
machine learning.coding_question: Write Python code to train a linear regression model and print the R2 score.

deep learning.why: Neural networks power modern image, speech, and NLP tasks
deep learning.learning_activity: Build a neural network with TensorFlow/Keras
deep learning.project: Train an image classifier on the MNIST dataset
deep learning.short_answer: Backpropagation calculates gradients to update neural network weights during training.

numpy.why: NumPy handles fast numerical computation underlying all ML libraries
numpy.learning_activity: Learn arrays, broadcasting, and matrix operations
numpy.project: Implement linear regression from scratch using NumPy
numpy.short_answer: Broadcasting lets NumPy perform operations on arrays of different shapes automatically.
numpy.coding_question: Write NumPy code to create a 3x3 matrix and compute its transpose.

data structures.why: Choosing the right data structure is key to writing efficient code
data structures.learning_activity: Study arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, hash maps
data structures.project: Implement a stack and queue from scratch
data structures.interview_question: What is the time complexity of searching in a hash map?
data structures.short_answer: Average case O(1) — hash maps provide constant-time lookups.
data structures.coding_question: Implement a stack using a Python list with push, pop, and peek methods.

algorithms.why: Algorithms determine how efficiently a program solves problems
algorithms.learning_activity: Practice sorting, searching, recursion, and dynamic programming on LeetCode
algorithms.project: Solve 20 LeetCode easy problems covering arrays and strings
algorithms.short_answer: DP breaks problems into overlapping subproblems and stores results to avoid recomputation.
algorithms.coding_question: Write a function to find the nth Fibonacci number using dynamic programming.

object oriented programming.why: OOP is the fundamental design paradigm of large software systems
object oriented programming.learning_activity: Learn classes, inheritance, encapsulation, and polymorphism
object oriented programming.project: Design a library management system using OOP
object oriented programming.interview_question: What are the four pillars of OOP?
object oriented programming.coding_question: Write a Python class BankAccount with deposit, withdraw, and get_balance methods.

java.why: Java is the core language for enterprise and Android development
java.learning_activity: Learn Java syntax, OOP, collections, and exception handling
java.project: Build a console-based bank account simulator
java.interview_question: What is the difference between an interface and an abstract class in Java?
java.short_answer: An interface defines a contract; an abstract class can have partial implementation.

spring boot.why: Spring Boot is the leading Java framework for building REST APIs and web apps
spring boot.learning_activity: Build a Spring Boot REST API with CRUD operations
spring boot.project: Create a Student Management REST API with Spring Boot
spring boot.interview_question: What is dependency injection in Spring?
spring boot.short_answer: Spring automatically injects required objects into a class instead of creating them manually.

maven.why: Maven manages Java project dependencies and build lifecycle
maven.learning_activity: Learn Maven POM.xml, dependency management, and build phases
maven.project: Set up a Maven multi-module Java project
maven.short_answer: pom.xml is the project object model file that defines dependencies and build configuration.

typescript.why: TypeScript adds static typing to JavaScript, reducing bugs in large codebases
typescript.learning_activity: Learn TypeScript types, interfaces, generics, and compile-time checking
typescript.project: Rewrite a JavaScript project in TypeScript with strict type checks
typescript.interview_question: What is the difference between TypeScript and JavaScript?
typescript.short_answer: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that adds static types checked at compile time.
typescript.coding_question: Write a TypeScript function that takes a string array and returns only strings longer than 3 characters.

node.js.why: Node.js enables JavaScript on the server side, used for fast backend APIs
node.js.learning_activity: Build a REST API with Node.js, Express, and a MongoDB database
node.js.project: Create a task management REST API with Express and MongoDB
node.js.interview_question: What is the event loop in Node.js?
node.js.short_answer: The event loop lets Node.js handle multiple requests without creating a new thread for each one.

mongodb.why: MongoDB is the most popular NoSQL database for flexible, document-based storage
mongodb.learning_activity: Learn CRUD operations, indexes, aggregation pipeline, and schema design
mongodb.project: Build a blog backend with Node.js and MongoDB
mongodb.interview_question: What is the difference between SQL and NoSQL databases?
mongodb.short_answer: SQL stores data in fixed tables with relationships; NoSQL stores flexible documents or key-value pairs.

docker.why: Docker packages applications in containers that run identically on any system
docker.learning_activity: Learn Dockerfile, docker build, docker run, and Docker Compose
docker.project: Containerise a Flask application with Docker and docker-compose
docker.interview_question: What is the difference between a Docker image and a Docker container?
docker.short_answer: An image is a template; a container is a running instance of that image.

kubernetes.why: Kubernetes orchestrates containers at scale, used in every major cloud deployment
kubernetes.learning_activity: Learn pods, deployments, services, and kubectl commands
kubernetes.project: Deploy a multi-container app on a local Kubernetes cluster using Minikube
kubernetes.short_answer: A pod is the smallest deployable unit in Kubernetes, containing one or more containers.

aws.why: AWS is the leading cloud platform; most companies deploy their infrastructure on it
aws.learning_activity: Learn EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, and RDS through the AWS free tier
aws.project: Host a static website on S3 and deploy a Lambda function
aws.interview_question: What is the difference between EC2 and Lambda in AWS?
aws.short_answer: EC2 is a virtual machine you manage; Lambda is serverless — it runs your code without managing servers.

ci/cd.why: CI/CD automates building, testing, and deploying code, reducing manual errors
ci/cd.learning_activity: Set up a GitHub Actions pipeline that builds and tests on every push
ci/cd.project: Create a CI/CD pipeline for a Flask app using GitHub Actions
ci/cd.interview_question: What is the difference between Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment?
ci/cd.short_answer: CI automatically tests every code change; CD automatically deploys the tested code to production.

networking.why: Understanding networking is essential for cybersecurity and DevOps roles
networking.learning_activity: Study OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, firewalls, and subnetting
networking.project: Set up a home lab network with VLANs and document the topology
networking.interview_question: What is the difference between TCP and UDP?
networking.short_answer: TCP is reliable and connection-oriented; UDP is faster but does not guarantee delivery.

angular.why: Angular is a full-featured TypeScript framework used for large enterprise frontends
angular.learning_activity: Learn Angular components, modules, services, routing, and HTTP client
angular.project: Build a student grade dashboard using Angular and a mock REST API
angular.interview_question: What is two-way data binding in Angular?
angular.short_answer: Two-way binding keeps the model and view in sync automatically using [(ngModel)].

vue.js.why: Vue.js is a progressive JavaScript framework easy to integrate into existing projects
vue.js.learning_activity: Learn Vue components, directives, Vuex state management, and Vue Router
vue.js.project: Build a shopping cart UI with Vue.js and local state management
vue.js.interview_question: What is the Vue.js reactivity system?
vue.js.short_answer: Vue automatically tracks data dependencies and re-renders only the affected parts of the UI.

postgresql.why: PostgreSQL is the most feature-rich open-source relational database used in production
postgresql.learning_activity: Learn advanced queries, stored procedures, indexes, and JSON support
postgresql.project: Design and populate a PostgreSQL database for an e-commerce system
postgresql.interview_question: What is a database index and when should you use one?
postgresql.short_answer: An index speeds up queries on a column; use it on frequently searched or joined columns.
postgresql.coding_question: Write a SQL query to find all orders placed in the last 30 days with a total above 500.

redis.why: Redis is an in-memory data store used for caching, sessions, and real-time features
redis.learning_activity: Learn Redis data types: strings, hashes, lists, sets, and sorted sets
redis.project: Add Redis caching to a Flask API to reduce database query time
redis.interview_question: What is Redis and what is it commonly used for?
redis.short_answer: Redis is an in-memory key-value store used for caching, session storage, and pub/sub messaging.

mysql.why: MySQL is one of the most widely deployed relational databases in the world
mysql.learning_activity: Practice CRUD operations, transactions, and stored procedures in MySQL
mysql.project: Build a student attendance system using MySQL as the backend
mysql.interview_question: What is the difference between MyISAM and InnoDB storage engines in MySQL?
mysql.short_answer: InnoDB supports transactions and foreign keys; MyISAM is faster for read-heavy tasks but no transactions.

linux administration.why: Servers, cloud VMs, and containers all run Linux; admin skills are non-negotiable
linux administration.learning_activity: Learn user management, cron jobs, systemd services, and log analysis
linux administration.project: Configure a Linux server with user accounts, firewall rules, and a cron backup job
linux administration.interview_question: How do you check disk usage and free memory on a Linux server?
linux administration.short_answer: Use `df -h` for disk usage and `free -h` or `top` for memory information.

bash scripting.why: Bash scripts automate repetitive server tasks and are core to DevOps workflows
bash scripting.learning_activity: Learn bash variables, loops, conditionals, functions, and cron scheduling
bash scripting.project: Write a bash script that backs up a directory and emails a report
bash scripting.interview_question: What does the shebang line #!/bin/bash do?
bash scripting.short_answer: It tells the OS to run this script using the bash interpreter found at /bin/bash.
bash scripting.coding_question: Write a bash script that counts the number of lines in all .log files in a directory.

penetration testing.why: Pen testing finds vulnerabilities before attackers do, a core skill in cybersecurity
penetration testing.learning_activity: Learn Kali Linux tools: nmap, Burp Suite, Metasploit, and Wireshark
penetration testing.project: Set up a home lab with a vulnerable VM and document a full pen test report
penetration testing.interview_question: What is the difference between black-box and white-box penetration testing?
penetration testing.short_answer: Black-box testers have no internal knowledge; white-box testers have full access to source code.

cryptography.why: Cryptography protects data in transit and at rest; every secure system depends on it
cryptography.learning_activity: Study symmetric/asymmetric encryption, hashing, TLS, and digital signatures
cryptography.project: Implement AES encryption and RSA key exchange in Python
cryptography.interview_question: What is the difference between symmetric and asymmetric encryption?
cryptography.short_answer: Symmetric uses one shared key; asymmetric uses a public key to encrypt and a private key to decrypt.

network security.why: Securing network infrastructure is a primary responsibility in cybersecurity roles
network security.learning_activity: Learn firewall configuration, IDS/IPS, VPN setup, and packet analysis
network security.project: Configure firewall rules on a Linux server and analyse traffic with Wireshark
network security.interview_question: What is a firewall and what types are there?
network security.short_answer: A firewall filters network traffic; types include packet-filtering, stateful, and application-layer firewalls.

vulnerability assessment.why: Identifying vulnerabilities is the first step in protecting any system or application
vulnerability assessment.learning_activity: Learn CVE databases, CVSS scoring, and tools like Nessus and OpenVAS
vulnerability assessment.project: Perform a vulnerability scan on a test network and write a formal report
vulnerability assessment.short_answer: CVE stands for Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures — a public list of known security flaws.

android sdk.why: The Android SDK provides all tools and APIs needed to build Android apps
android sdk.learning_activity: Learn Activity lifecycle, Intents, RecyclerView, and permissions
android sdk.project: Build a note-taking app with a RecyclerView list and room database
android sdk.interview_question: What is the Activity lifecycle in Android?
android sdk.short_answer: The lifecycle is onCreate, onStart, onResume, onPause, onStop, onDestroy — managing app state at each stage.

kotlin.why: Kotlin is the preferred modern language for Android development recommended by Google
kotlin.learning_activity: Learn Kotlin syntax, null safety, data classes, coroutines, and extensions
kotlin.project: Rebuild a Java Android app in Kotlin using data classes and coroutines
kotlin.interview_question: What is null safety in Kotlin?
kotlin.short_answer: Kotlin makes null values explicit with ? types, preventing NullPointerExceptions at compile time.
kotlin.coding_question: Write a Kotlin function that takes a nullable string and returns its length or 0 if null.

xml layouts.why: Android UI is defined in XML layouts; understanding them is required for all Android apps
xml layouts.learning_activity: Learn ConstraintLayout, LinearLayout, RelativeLayout, and View binding
xml layouts.project: Design a login screen with a profile image, two text fields, and a submit button
xml layouts.short_answer: ConstraintLayout positions views relative to each other or the parent using constraints, like a flexible grid.

sqlite.why: SQLite is the built-in local database on Android used for offline data storage
sqlite.learning_activity: Learn Room Database ORM: entities, DAOs, and queries in Android
sqlite.project: Add offline storage to your note app using Room and SQLite
sqlite.interview_question: What is Room Database in Android?
sqlite.short_answer: Room is an ORM layer over SQLite that lets you query a local database using annotated Java/Kotlin objects.

firebase.why: Firebase provides real-time database, authentication, and cloud storage for mobile apps
firebase.learning_activity: Learn Firebase Auth, Firestore, and Firebase Cloud Messaging
firebase.project: Add Google login and real-time chat to your Android app using Firebase
firebase.interview_question: What is the difference between Firebase Realtime Database and Firestore?
firebase.short_answer: Realtime Database stores JSON and syncs instantly; Firestore is a more scalable document database.

database design.why: Good schema design determines how well a database handles growth and queries
database design.learning_activity: Learn ER diagrams, normalisation (1NF to 3NF), and schema design patterns
database design.project: Design a normalised relational schema for a hospital management system
database design.short_answer: Normalisation organises tables to remove redundancy and ensure data integrity through normal forms.

query optimization.why: Slow queries are the most common performance bottleneck in production databases
query optimization.learning_activity: Learn EXPLAIN plans, indexes, query rewriting, and execution analysis
query optimization.project: Identify and fix 5 slow queries in a sample database using EXPLAIN
query optimization.interview_question: What is an execution plan and how do you use it?
query optimization.short_answer: An execution plan shows how the database executes a query; use EXPLAIN to find slow steps and add indexes.

backup recovery.why: Data loss without backups can destroy a company; DBAs are responsible for backup strategy
backup recovery.learning_activity: Learn full, incremental, and differential backups; practice restore procedures
backup recovery.project: Automate daily database backups with a bash script and test a full restore
backup recovery.interview_question: What is the difference between a full backup and an incremental backup?
backup recovery.short_answer: Full backup copies all data; incremental backup copies only data changed since the last backup.

replication.why: Database replication provides high availability and read scalability in production systems
replication.learning_activity: Learn master-slave replication, read replicas, and failover configuration
replication.project: Set up MySQL master-slave replication between two local database instances
replication.interview_question: What is database replication and why is it used?
replication.short_answer: Replication copies data from one database to another for redundancy and faster read performance.

cloud computing.why: Cloud is the standard deployment platform; every modern app runs in the cloud
cloud computing.learning_activity: Learn cloud concepts: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and study AWS or GCP free tier
cloud computing.project: Deploy a web application on AWS EC2 and connect it to an RDS database
cloud computing.interview_question: What is the difference between IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS?
cloud computing.short_answer: IaaS gives raw infrastructure, PaaS provides a managed platform, SaaS delivers ready-to-use software.

terraform.why: Terraform lets you define and provision infrastructure as code, ensuring repeatability
terraform.learning_activity: Learn HCL syntax, providers, resources, state files, and terraform plan/apply
terraform.project: Write Terraform code to provision an EC2 instance and S3 bucket on AWS
terraform.short_answer: IaC means defining infrastructure (servers, networks) in config files so it can be versioned and automated.

ansible.why: Ansible automates server configuration and application deployment using simple YAML playbooks
ansible.learning_activity: Learn inventory files, playbooks, roles, and idempotent task writing
ansible.project: Write an Ansible playbook to install and configure Nginx on three servers
ansible.interview_question: What does idempotent mean in the context of Ansible?
ansible.short_answer: Idempotent means running the same playbook multiple times produces the same result without side effects.

jenkins.why: Jenkins is the most widely used open-source CI/CD automation server
jenkins.learning_activity: Learn Jenkins pipelines, Jenkinsfile syntax, and integration with git
jenkins.project: Set up a Jenkins pipeline that builds and tests a Python app on every commit
jenkins.short_answer: A Jenkinsfile defines the CI/CD pipeline as code stored in the project repository.

prometheus.why: Prometheus collects metrics from infrastructure and applications for alerting and dashboards
prometheus.learning_activity: Learn PromQL queries, metrics types (counter, gauge, histogram), and alert rules
prometheus.project: Set up Prometheus and Grafana to monitor a Flask application's response time
prometheus.interview_question: What is the difference between Prometheus and a traditional monitoring tool?
prometheus.short_answer: Prometheus scrapes metrics from targets using pull model; traditional tools use push or agent-based collection.

monitoring.why: System monitoring detects issues before they become outages in production
monitoring.learning_activity: Learn metrics, logs, and traces; set up Grafana dashboards and alert rules
monitoring.project: Monitor a web server using Prometheus and create a Grafana dashboard
monitoring.interview_question: What are the three pillars of observability?
monitoring.short_answer: The three pillars are Metrics (numbers over time), Logs (event records), and Traces (request paths).

r programming.why: R is widely used in academia and data science for statistical analysis and visualisation
r programming.learning_activity: Learn R data frames, ggplot2 for visualisation, and tidyverse for data wrangling
r programming.project: Perform exploratory data analysis on a public health dataset using R and ggplot2
r programming.interview_question: What is the difference between R and Python for data science?
r programming.short_answer: R excels at statistics and visualisation; Python is more versatile for ML, scripting, and production deployment.

feature engineering.why: Good features make the biggest difference in model accuracy; feature engineering is critical
feature engineering.learning_activity: Learn encoding, scaling, binning, polynomial features, and feature selection
feature engineering.project: Engineer features for the Titanic dataset and improve a baseline model's accuracy
feature engineering.interview_question: What is feature engineering and why does it matter?
feature engineering.short_answer: Feature engineering transforms raw data into informative inputs that help models learn patterns better.

nlp.why: NLP enables machines to understand human language — used in chatbots, search, and translation
nlp.learning_activity: Learn tokenisation, TF-IDF, word embeddings, and sentiment analysis
nlp.project: Build a sentiment analysis model for product reviews using scikit-learn
nlp.short_answer: Tokenisation splits text into smaller units (words or subwords) so a model can process them numerically.

computer vision.why: Computer vision powers face recognition, medical imaging, and autonomous systems
computer vision.learning_activity: Learn image processing with OpenCV and CNNs with Keras for image classification
computer vision.project: Train a CNN to classify handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset
computer vision.interview_question: What is a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)?
computer vision.short_answer: A CNN uses convolutional layers to detect local features in images, making it ideal for visual tasks.

model deployment.why: A model that cannot be deployed to production has no real-world value
model deployment.learning_activity: Learn Flask/FastAPI model serving, Docker packaging, and cloud deployment
model deployment.project: Deploy a trained scikit-learn model as a REST API using Flask and Docker
model deployment.interview_question: What is model drift and how do you detect it?
model deployment.short_answer: Model drift is when a model's accuracy drops because real-world data changed; detect with performance monitoring.
